id: 7b1f9c83-2d44-4ab8-8e91-3f5a6c2b9d12

  - https://www.sygnia.co/blog/operation-highland-velvet-ant/
  - https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/security/chinese-hackers-hijack-auth-flow-spy-on-isolated-network-for-a-decade/

  category: file_event

  selection_path:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/lib/security/pam_'
      - '/lib64/security/pam_'
      - '/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib64/security/pam_'
      - '/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/security/pam_'

  product: linux

      - '/usr/sbin/smbd'
      - '/usr/local/sbin/smbd'
